Name: MemeMixer
Author: MemeMixer
Description: Mutes, volume, VU meters, scenes and pages for MemeMixer (Biamp Tesira headphone mixer). Set up which key does what on MemeMixer's Stream Deck page.

Actions.Name: Open MemeMixer
Actions.Tooltip: Switches to the MemeMixer profile. Put it on your usual profile; the X key in MemeMixer brings you back.

Actions.Name: MemeMixer Key
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the MemeMixer key set up for this position (MemeMixer → Stream Deck page).
